Goodbye, Iowa. Hello, Michigan. Which Democratic primaries will matter most in 2028?. South Carolina will vote first, which could help moderates. But Michigan and Virginia may hold the real power.

The good news for Rs: D chances in Florida have fallen from ~20% to ~10% with Nixon instead of Vindman. tbh I think the model was overrating Vindman because of his fundraising. But this is another cycle where Ds might be punting on what used to be an iconic swing state.

There's a perception that Democrats tend to win in the true swing states (i.e. Georgia) but can't really win in deeper red states. But in 2018 they won Senate races in Ohio, Montana and yes West Virigina, albeit with incumbents. (And Alabama in a special election in 2017.)
